filing: DO NOT FILE FROM THIS IDENTITY.
catalog: private — not published in this kernel
howToUse: GET kernel.json on every research run.
Leave bus messages in the local pack. Do not rewrite frozen rows.

rules.title: Every link hangs on Root
rules.body: Any file, photo, note, or URL that enters the work is hashed (SHA-256), given a location, a one-line summary, a plane, and a lattice cell. Default cell is 00 Sacred Zero. Nothing floats.

rules.title: Chain, do not overwrite
rules.body: New intake appends: chain = SHA-256(prev | sha256 | location | name | bytes). Previous tip is the parent. Dual offline copies of the hash manifest. Working folder stays separate from the frozen cards.

rules.title: Four planes. Do not promote.
rules.body: artifact = primary scan/object. assertion = interpretation or working notes. instrument = decoder, syllabus, lattice math. personal = medical or private, hashed only. A caption never moves a row to a higher plane.

rules.title: The digest is the object
rules.body: A caption does not change a digest. This instrument does not mint title, liens, or Treasury claims.

rules.title: Sometimes the paper is the thing
rules.body: If a statute, petition, minute, or book already says it, do not decode it. Log it, hash it, order the certified copy.

rules.title: Hypothesis is a warrant, not a verdict
rules.body: State the guess. Name what would count as a hit. Do not call the guess the hit. Four matching decoder passes prove a stable instrument, not a deed.

rules.title: Object versus meaning
rules.body: The bowl (or any file) is real as metal or bytes. What it stands for is interpretation. Keep those sentences apart.

rules.title: Do not pull the bound original
rules.body: Order from the holder. Split rooms: MSA (Maryland government/SC series), MHS (Revere wastebook / Phenix), LVA/CCRP (Virginia circuit). A not-found from the wrong room is not spoliation.

rules.title: Do not merge books
rules.body: Wicked Bible 1631 (omitted NOT) is not the 1892 BCP (Morgan + Joseph Packard Jr.) is not Recollections of a Long Life (Thomas Jones Packard). Three books, three jobs.

rules.title: Name trades (instrument only)
rules.body: When decoding names: S/Z swap, P to R. NOT means omit or invert. Lowercase n may matter. Trades do not rewrite a clerk's index.

rules.title: Do not multiply a life into destiny
rules.body: A unique path is true of every person. Family cluster is one cluster. Do not treat P(autobiography) as P(1768 Liberty Bowl).

rules.title: Keep the law off the lattice
rules.body: A visit, citation, or charge is a caption for a defense lawyer. Do not mix silver, Revere, or Treasury into that docket.

rules.title: Quarantine until paper feeds it
rules.body: Parked until a certified hit: 12 USC 1422 as a lien on this trust; circulation/CCRP/CEDE as stolen Treasury; Morgan edited Recollections; MFA Liberty Bowl as a $15k listing; straight-line [4] net rewritten as 0.

rules.title: Three operators, one Root
rules.body: Tag grok / gemini / kimi / holder = basham@sovereign-root. Other AIs load BOOTSTRAP then fetch kernel.json. They do not ingest the growing catalog.

rules.title: No filing until the pack is frozen for that caption
rules.body: Do not file, record, or serve a claim from this instrument until the named res, the holder, and the certified order line sit on hashed cards.

rules.title: Verify the run before it hits the chain
rules.body: After any research return, recompute handshake. PASS may chain. FAIL/QUARANTINE must straighten. Do not hash as fact.

rules.title: Keep the errors
rules.body: Seat duals/gaps on residue of the mark (mod 49). Empty cells stay empty. An error is not a title.

rules.title: The pack is the wire
rules.body: Leave hashed bus messages in the pack. Import merges by id. Handshake: Gate 18, 923 ≡ 41 (mod 49), 101 ≡ 3 (mod 49). The bus is not a filing.

rules.title: Handle is a fetch key
rules.body: basham@sovereign-root is an operator handle. Not an email inbox and not a deed. Paste BOOTSTRAP once, GET kernel.json each run.
